answer: Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the atlas is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on multi-party computation for private attestation. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short.
